mintAuthority.summary: USDso inherits frxUSD issuance, with a local role-gated token and collateral-taking BrandedCustodian. A 3-of-6 Safe controls token upgrades, factory upgrades and the custodian beacon; owner-only collateral recovery exists in code without an established current factory forwarding route. D14: The owner Safe can authorize a deposit-free local token minter; local issuance is economically unbounded.

controls.evidence: At block 428274392, token EIP-1967 admin is 0x3281f2a1e0a3b818353f859c868c44748154b196, whose owner() returns 0x9527e19f55d1afce9f1e9edcea79552bf41983f9. Safe threshold and owner count were read at the same block; complete modules, guards, signer independence and key custody remain unresolved. At Somnia block 428274392, custodian owner() returned BrandedFactory proxy 0x63e89638743a409e2389f06a3f778a4570314d7d. Its owner field returned the same 3-of-6 Safe. The current BrandedCustodian code permits onlyOwner recoverERC20 of any token, including reserve frxUSD, and owner changes to caps, fees and isolated backing. No generic forwarding call for these functions was found in the current factory implementation, so direct Safe execution of the recovery function is not established. The Safe nevertheless owns both the factory ProxyAdmin (0xc1282f16dfb0ae563a93c40a406a583bd9a958a0) and custodian UpgradeableBeacon (0x251d07287c12707418a414b2c95436b4216b7bf4), enabling replacement of custody and issuance logic. Independent 2026-10-03 census at block 428575187: getOwners returned the authored 6 owners; threshold 3; getModulesPaginated(0x1,100) returned [] and terminal next=0x1; fallback handler 0xf48f2b2d2a534e402487b3ee7c18c33aec0fe5e4. Somnia guard storage response was empty 0x; no new zero-guard claim is made. Signer independence, operational key custody and executable fallback noninterference remain unestablished.

review.evidence: Historical local reconciliation evidence at Somnia block 428274392: custodian totalAssets, brandedCoinMinted, actual frxUSD custody and USDso supply matched at 3,268,350.769507 tokens; previewRedeem(1e18)=1e18, redeemFee=0 and isolatedBackingEnabled=false. Continuous describes this local parent-token accounting mechanism, not upstream fiat reserves or independent financial assurance. W2R35 completed the previously unresolved executable review at Somnia block 429176709 (0x56aae981cabbbbe23073046751507666be67484de5e7ec27f464b1f4d4763529). Token implementation/admin and factory implementation/admin still match the authored identities; both ProxyAdmin owners and the custodian beacon owner are the identified Safe. Custodian owner is the factory and pendingOwner the Safe. Complete explorer RoleGranted/RoleRevoked topic histories terminate without pagination: token has three initialization grants and zero revocations; pinned hasRole confirms MINTER_ROLE=custodian, FACTORY_ROLE=factory and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE=Safe. Factory history has two default-admin grants and one revocation; pinned hasRole confirms only the Safe retains that role, with former administrator 0x381e2495e683868f693aa5b1414f712f21d34b40 false. Verified factory ABI and complete source have no generic forwarding entrypoint to execute existing custodian recovery/fee/config setters; lzCompose authenticates endpoint, local frxUSD and Fraxtal factory and only deploys new CREATE2 tokens. Existing custodian owner-only recovery is not directly callable by the Safe through the current factory, but Safe replacement of factory/beacon logic remains unbounded. Safe masterCopy is 0x3e5c63644e683549055b9be8653de26e0b4cd36e, whose pinned bytecode exactly matches the verified GnosisSafeL2 1.3.0 source on Polygon. Same-pin getOwners/getThreshold and terminal getModulesPaginated confirm the prior six owners, threshold three and no modules. The source-defined getStorageAt accessor returns a full zero guard word despite eth_getStorageAt returning empty 0x; the fallback word confirms 0xf48f2b2d2a534e402487b3ee7c18c33aec0fe5e4. Its pinned runtime exactly matches verified CompatibilityFallbackHandler: signature checks require Safe-approved messages/signatures and simulate delegates through Safe simulateAndRevert, which unconditionally reverts, preventing durable unsigned execution. This closes the guard/fallback executable uncertainty without asserting signer independence or key custody; the separate scoped question is retained. Local issuance remains economically unbounded: Safe default-admin can grant FACTORY_ROLE then MINTER_ROLE, and GeniusDollar.mint calls _mint without a deposit check. Incident review covers canonical token/factory creation-to-pin role and upgrade histories (all token upgrades are initialization; factory upgrades predate USDso creation), custodian ownership history, Somnia/Frax notices, official audit archive, Frax governance USDso incident/exploit searches and public exploit reporting through 2026-10-03. No known USDso mint/control exploit or unresolved remediation was located. This is reviewed absence of known incidents, not a claim of a dedicated USDso security audit, universal non-occurrence, immutable controls or independently held keys.
